notes: Observed dashboard behavior; the exact prompt was not tested in a general chat interface.

prompt_used: Inspect the explanation for unavailable audience reports and determine whether the tool explains the source or limitation of its claims.
observed_response_summary: The dashboard explained that age, gender and city breakdowns may be withheld below YouTube reporting thresholds, while the top-countries report returned no rows due to limited activity.
reason_for_score: The dashboard explained why audience data was unavailable rather than fabricating demographics.
notes: This evaluates transparency of the dashboard explanation, not the accuracy of every underlying threshold rule.
